businesses.business: used vehicle wholesale marketplaces and services

offering_description.value: Operates online wholesale marketplaces where automakers, dealers, fleet operators, rental companies and financial institutions buy and sell used vehicles. It finances used vehicle inventory for independent dealers and provides auction software, vehicle data, inspections, shipping and vehicle recovery and remarketing services.

quotes.quote: We bring together the leading OEMs, dealers, fleet operators, rental companies and financial institutions to match the right buyer with the right car for every lot.
Helping independent dealers grow their business faster by providing financing for used vehicle inventory.
